notes.title: One-Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Can you believe it? It's been a whole year since [i]Mission; It's Complicated[/i] launched!

We won't talk any more about 2020, because... well... Yikes.
But - regardless, we're so glad to have given you the opportunity to save the world from being devoured in this universe! And if you haven't yet... What are you waiting for?!

To celebrate [i]M:IC[/i]'s launch anniversary, we've put together a fun, little quiz for you.
You've shipped the team together in countless combinations for various definitions of true love... but now it's time to match our heroes with YOU! Who is YOUR [i]Mission: It's Complicated[/i] Match?
[url=https://www.tryinteract.com/share/quiz/6025b0aede547d001765d5f6]Find out here[/url] and then share your results with us [url=https://twitter.com/Pugsly_MIC]via Twitter![/url]

And of course, you can always check out [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RHb6nZaegFTFoPg_K_t3uhHqq1ruX19E]our lovely line of Valentine's Day cards,[/url] if you're a last-minute celebrater like I am.

Again, we can't thank you enough for helping us save the world with the power of love and for your continued support of [i]Mission: it's Complicated[/i].

Stay safe, stay strong, and love hard!

notes.title: New Update, Heroes!
notes.notes: Hey folks! Just a quick note to say that a new version of Mission: It's Complicated should now be available. This update should fix the (rare) bug a few folks have run into with bad saves giving them a white screen they can't move past. You should once again be able to start the game -- if you still can't, please let us know!

notes.title: Mission: It's Complicated is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Gird up your loins, Heroes!

I always wanted to say that. 

You, Professor L, must gather a group of heroes and save the world from impending DOOM!

Impending...you have like, 12 days.

Good luck!

notes.title: Mission: It's Complicated Release
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

Mission: It's Complicated is a narrative-based visual novel where you pair up superheroes and go on missions in order to save the world.

But there's a catch...the heroes have to fall in love in order for the Earth to be saved!

It could be friendly love, or like..[i]love[/i], love. You know...[i]bow chicka wow wow[/i] love.

Stay tuned for more information! Your missions start in February 2020!
